name: Marcus Chen
bio: Software engineer by day, marathoner by dawn. Runs 50+ miles/week. Chasing a sub-3:10 marathon PR. Obsessed with splits, training load, and VO2 max trends. Hates charging devices mid-training-block.
pain_points: Wants training readiness score to know when to push vs. recover
Needs 14-day battery — refuses to charge mid-week
VO2 max tracking and race predictor for goal-setting
Lightweight — won't run with a brick on his wrist
